assertions.name: schwinger_brings_alpha_within_3sigma
assertions.source: form B (proton + derived Schwinger) resid +0.313 ppb < 3σ (=0.45 ppb)

description: The alpha_EM ladder at the proton pin, scored against the CODATA reference READ FROM THE REGISTRY (qou_substrate.codata, CODATA 2022) rather than a hardcoded edition: form A (quadratic, no Schwinger) resid +0.9937 ppb (6.48 sigma) -> form B (+derived Schwinger (1-h^2 alpha), RT phase 3) resid -0.3652 ppb (2.38 sigma). The 2018->2022 edition shift is 0.6787 ppb, 2.2x the form-B residual, and FLIPS its sign (+0.3134 -> -0.3652); magnitude and sigma count barely move. Against the L2 100x target (0.0015325 ppb) form B still misses by 238.3x -- the 2.38 sigma is the 1x comparison, not the L2 one, and the two must not be conflated. Remaining 2-loop c2 ~ -9.4e-4 (uncomputed, NOT Ohtsuki kappa1=0.554; the sign is the edition flip). Closest any not-yet-met observable sits to its L2 target: 238x vs 970x (m_mu) and 152-177x (Q_beta trio). Schwinger factor NOT FITTED (measured: the c hitting CODATA exactly is 0.7312340272, 1-sigma window [0.61846303, 0.84400502], so the published c=1 is OUTSIDE it at 2.383 sigma) but NOT DERIVED either -- the exact vertex-moment check (2026-07-14 audit) gives +0.1281 vs the claimed -0.0437, wrong order and sign; honest tier is structurally-motivated / empirically-anchored. q0 = documented proton pin; scope-(a).
